description: A new light vector boson that couples to neutrinos.

questions.question: What is the mass of the new vector boson?
questions.reason: 10 MeV is a common light-mediator benchmark in CEvNS studies; the description says only 'light' and gives no mass.

questions.question: What is the left-handed coupling g_nu^{ee} in Z'_mu g_nu^{ee} nu-bar_e gamma^mu P_L nu_e to electron neutrinos?
questions.reason: 1e-4 is a common order-of-magnitude benchmark for light-mediator couplings; answer 0 if the boson does not couple to this flavor, since the description does not say which flavors it couples to.

questions.question: What is the vector coupling g_u in Z'_mu g_u u-bar gamma^mu u to up quarks?
What is the vector coupling g_d in Z'_mu g_d d-bar gamma^mu d to down quarks?

answers.free_text: mass 30 MeV, coupling 1e-4 to all three left-handed neutrino flavors and the same coupling 1e-4 to both u and d quarks, nothing else
